The '''Kemu Clan''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] clan on the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. They considered the [[Bomu Clan]] to be inept. [[Reen Irana]] sat with a group of [[Accountant/Legends|accountants]] from the Kemu Clan during a gathering in [[Popara's penthouse]].
